{{Top|leg}}
'''Molecular solvent''' was a harmless chemical. It could be used to disolve the [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]]s of [[Biodegradable Binders]] if the wearer of the restraints had to be freed earlier than the thirty-six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] the binders lasted for.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
